regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-tier Canada/TSX tape: Base Metals & Copper leads with Oil & Gas Producers a close challenger, both eligible, uncrowded, and durable above their bars. But the base-metals leader is tagged mean-revert, rotation is broad (9/16 eligible) rather than one-narrative, and the backtest says momentum rank is a focus lens only — so this is a stay-with-the-trends, de-risk-the-tails tape, not a predictive one.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Base Metals & Copper's mean-revert tag tightens into trend while Oil & Gas maintains its higher durability_bar: a confirmed leader margin widening beyond the current 0.11 in rotation would retire the watch and mark a cleaner one-narrative structure.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is rank 2, eligible, uncrowded, with the highest durability_bar of the leaders (0.61 vs base metals 0.5), suggesting the staying-power leg has the cleanest risk-control profile here. It is the challenger within a broad rotation and not flagged for reflexive crowding, so a size-and-hold lean fits the discipline's validated drawdown-control edge.
evidence: hurst_tag mixed (not mean-revert like the headline leader)
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is late-cycle and headline-sensitive to crude; a macro-driven oil pullback would hit this theme even if its internal trend-health is intact, and the detector has no return-forecasting edge.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% over 20 trading days despite remaining rank-eligible.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is the nominal leader, eligible and uncrowded with positive breadth (0.556). It is supported by the focus lens of rank 1, but its mean-revert hurst_tag and a durability_bar at exactly 0.5 argue for a restrained, vol-aware lean rather than a strong one, consistent with 'discipline not prediction.'
evidence: hurst_tag mean-revert flags weaker trend persistence
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag is the strongest contrary case: leadership could decay quickly, and with cross-sectional rank-IC near zero this leader is an attention anchor, not an alpha source.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms XEG.TO by more than 3% over 20 trading days while both stay eligible.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the only crowded theme (crowding_z 1.16, crowded=true) and is not a top-5 leader, yet it remains eligible. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a short or fade. The lean is to avoid adding here rather than bet against it, acknowledging the reflexivity risk of fading.
theses.dissent: The durability_bar is actually strong at 0.63 among eligible names, and crowded does not mean topping; avoiding may miss continued trendy upside if flows persist.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outranks the top-3 leaders on score within 20 trading days while staying uncrowded.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
